title: sieve: RFC 5260 date and index extensions
description: Implement RFC 5260 date and index extensions in crates/sieve/src/extensions/date.rs. Activated by require 'date'. New tests: date [:zone] [:index <n> [:last]] <header-name> <date-part> <key-list> — extracts named date-part from a date-bearing header and matches against key-list. Supported date-parts: year (4 digits), month (01-12), day (01-31), hour (00-23), minute (00-59), second (00-59), weekday (0=Sunday..6=Saturday), zone (+hhmm/-hhmm), std11 (full RFC 2822 date string). currentdate [:zone] <date-part> <key-list> — same but uses system time. :zone argument overrides timezone. :index n selects the nth occurrence of the header (1-based); :last selects the last. Date parsing: RFC 2822 date format (e.g. 'Mon, 01 Jan 2024 12:00:00 +0000'). No external crate for date parsing — implement RFC 2822 date parser directly. Tests: extract year/month/day from Date header, currentdate year matches, :index 2 selects second Received header, :last selects last. Oracle: RFC 5260 §5 examples.
